commentary.text: 90+3' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
90+3' Barcelona earn a corner.
90+2' Betis fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Barcelona) leaps to collect the ball.
90+1' Hector Bellerin (Betis) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
89' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
87' Barcelona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
85' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Antony and he is replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).
85' Robert Lewandowski will be replaced by Marc Casado (Barcelona).

83' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
83' Barcelona take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
83' Marc Roca (Betis) is penalised for holding. Guillermo Cuadra signals a set piece. Barcelona get a free kick.
81' A cross from a corner kick by Barcelona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
81' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Barcelona will have a corner.
80' Sofyan Amrabat comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marc Roca (Betis).
79' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) replaces Abde Ezzalzouli.
78' Antony (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
75' Substitution. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) replaces Marc Bernal.

74' 3 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) and Pedri gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 3:1.
73' Antony (Betis) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
72' A pass by Antony (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
70' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
69' 2 - 1 Goal! Isco (Betis) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Joan Garcia into the bottom right corner.
69' Isco (Betis) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
68' Referee Guillermo Cuadra awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
66' There's a break in play and referee Guillermo Cuadra must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Betis using VAR. This could be interesting!
63' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Eric Garcia is replaced by Ronald Araujo (Barcelona).
63' Substitution. Raphinha did his best and is replaced by Roony Bardghji (Barcelona).

62' 2 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Raphinha (Barcelona) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:0.
60' Raphinha (Barcelona) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
57' Hector Bellerin (Betis) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Joan Garcia. Betis will take a corner kick.

57' Raphinha (Barcelona) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
54' Good movement by Jules Kounde (Barcelona), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
52' The attendance is 56870.

50' What a chance that is! Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
49' A pass from Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is intercepted by Alvaro Valles and the move breaks down.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Hansi Flick gives a chance to Alejandro Balde and Fermín (Barcelona) is off.
46' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Cedric Bakambu comes on the pitch for Alvaro Fidalgo (Betis).
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a half-time substitution. Isco comes on in place of Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.

45' Fermín (Barcelona) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the roof of the net, but Alvaro Valles was alert and made an amazing save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' A corner kick by Betis is thwarted by the well prepared Joan Garcia (Barcelona).

43' Antony (Betis) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
43' The ball is out of play. Betis win a corner kick.
40' The Barcelona players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
38' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Jules Kounde (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
36' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the right post is saved by Joan Garcia.
33' The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.
30' Junior Firpo (Betis) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
30' Fermín (Barcelona) brings his opponent down. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Betis will take a free kick.

28' 1 - 0 Raphinha (Barcelona) unleashes a shot from the free kick just outside the box, and his brilliant low drive goes inside the left post. Football supporters are always happy to see such a fabulous goal.
28' Raphinha (Barcelona) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
27' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Junior Firpo (Betis) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Barcelona.
26' Alvaro Fidalgo (Betis) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Joan Garcia comes off his line to intercept.
23' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) has a goal ruled out for offside!
22' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
21' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
19' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
19' Barcelona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Barcelona.

18' Alvaro Valles was forced into action to thwart Raphinha (Barcelona). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper. Barcelona get a corner.
16' Fermín (Barcelona) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
15' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
13' Gavi (Barcelona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
10' The foul by Gavi (Barcelona) was seen by Guillermo Cuadra who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' Barcelona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
7' Fermín (Barcelona) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
4' Raphinha (Barcelona) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Alvaro Valles.
3' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
2' Valentin Gomez (Betis) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillermo Cuadra saw the whole situation. Barcelona win a free kick.
